use_case: Transaction fraud-detection model scoring every authorization on both platforms and driving automatic declines above a threshold
business_owner: Director of Fraud and Merchant Risk
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted model built by the data science team (SYS-11), in production since 2025-06-30; retrained monthly on tokenized transactions
data_categories: Tokens (never PAN); amount, time, merchant category; BIN country and card type; billing ZIP code; device and IP signals for card-not-present; fraud and chargeback labels
consequential_decision_category: None of the listed categories directly (the issuer makes the credit decision). High tier because it runs inline in payment infrastructure and declines consumer purchases automatically
human_in_the_loop: No human before real-time declines (not feasible at up to 260 per second). Compensating design: automatic decline only at the top score band; middle band to step-up authentication or merchant review; analysts review escalations and a monthly sample of declines; merchants and ISVs can allow-list customers
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45 (claims to merchants; unfair practices); 16 CFR 314.4 (customer information in training data); PCI DSS 3.2.1 and 6.2 (training data and model code); Colorado SB26-189 (effective 2027-01-01) and California ADMT rules (compliance by 2027-01-01): applicability to be assessed by counsel

use_case: Merchant underwriting and risk monitoring: vendor risk score at onboarding and monthly rescoring that set approval, reserve, and processing limits for merchants, including sole proprietors
vendor_or_model: Vendor merchant risk scoring service (SYS-13) plus company rules
data_categories: Merchant owner identity and credit-bureau-derived attributes (from the vendor); business type, age, and category; processing history; chargeback ratios
consequential_decision_category: Financial services (approval and terms of merchant processing; reserves on funds). Whether it is "credit" under ECOA and Regulation B is to be confirmed by counsel
human_in_the_loop: Underwriters review every decline and every reserve above 10%; approvals below the auto-approve threshold go to an underwriter. Reason codes not yet shown to underwriters
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45; ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002) applicability to merchant processing to be confirmed by counsel; Colorado SB26-189 (financial or lending services) and California ADMT rules applicability to be assessed by counsel; 16 CFR 314.4(f) (vendor oversight)
status: In production; validation and bias test due 2026-12-31

use_case: Dispute representment drafting assistant: drafts chargeback responses from transaction records and merchant evidence for analyst review
business_owner: Director of Fraud and Merchant Risk
vendor_or_model: Generative AI feature in the dispute management SaaS (large language model hosted by the SaaS vendor)
data_categories: Transaction details (masked PAN), merchant evidence (receipts, delivery records), cardholder names
human_in_the_loop: Analysts review and edit every draft before submission; no automatic submission
applicable_laws: PCI DSS 3.4.1 and 12.8 (masked PAN only; vendor is a service provider); 16 CFR 314.4(f); card network dispute rules (accuracy of submissions)
status: Approved with conditions; vendor no-training terms signed 2026-09-10

use_case: Merchant support chatbot on the website and in the portals: answers questions about deposits, fees, and settings and hands off to agents
vendor_or_model: Generative AI chatbot SaaS grounded on the company knowledge base
data_categories: Merchant questions; merchant ID; deposit status from a read-only API. Risk: merchants type card numbers into chat
human_in_the_loop: Agent handoff on request or on low confidence; no account changes through the chatbot; disclosure that the user is talking to an AI
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45 (accuracy of statements about fees and funding); PCI DSS 3.2.1 (PAN in chat transcripts); 16 CFR 314.4(f)
status: In production since 2026-03; PAN masking due 2026-12-31

use_case: Engineering code assistant used by developers on both platforms, including CDE repositories
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI coding assistant with no-training and no-retention terms
data_categories: Source code and configuration; no production data permitted
human_in_the_loop: Developers review all suggestions; AI-assisted pull requests labeled and security-reviewed for CDE repositories (POL-05 4.8)
applicable_laws: PCI DSS 6.2.3 and 6.2.4 (secure development and code review); 16 CFR 314.4(c)(4)
status: Approved with conditions (labeling and review rule live 2026-10-31)
